## Challenge

Propose a different protected low-voltage project using at least one approved input, useful Linux/Python behaviour, and one safely interfaced output.

## Approval required before building

- measurable success criteria;
- exact schematic and signal/interface table;
- datasheets or official documentation;
- bill of materials, budget, and confirmed availability;
- staged test plan and safe state;
- fallback using classroom stock or simulated input.

| Minimum | Proficient | Extension |
|---|---|---|
| One input, one low-current output, and small Python behaviour | State machine/decision, log or graph, and driver/interface stage | Second sensor/output or carefully justified new component |

## Non-negotiable limits

No direct high-current load from GPIO. No unverified 5 V signal into 3.3 V GPIO. No signal above the exact ADC maximum. No purchasing or powered wiring before teacher approval.

## Portfolio evidence

Approved proposal/BOM, schematic, interface limits, calculations, test results, three trials, one diagnosed fault, code/log evidence, conclusion, sources, and privacy check.
